subject: Early Science & Nature
standard_explanation: Biological entities (living organisms) possess defining biological characteristics: cellular organization, metabolic nutrient assimilation, respiration, biological growth and development, homeostasis, reproduction, and responsiveness to environmental stimuli. Non-living objects do not grow, metabolize, or reproduce independently.
simplified_explanation: Let's learn who is ALIVE and who is not! A puppy is a living thing—it runs, breathes air, eats food, and grows big! A green plant is living—it drinks water and grows tall towards the sun! But a toy car or a stone is non-living—it does not eat, it does not breathe, and it stays the same size forever!
key_points: Living things need water, food, and air to grow.
Living things can grow bigger and have baby plants or baby animals.
Non-living things (like chairs, rocks, and toys) do not eat or grow.
Trees, birds, fish, and people are all wonderful living things!
examples: A tiny seed growing into a tall sunflower is a living thing.
A plastic toy brick that stays the exact same size is a non-living thing.
misconceptions: Misconception: Because clouds move across the sky, they are alive. Fact: Clouds are moved by wind; they do not eat, grow cells, or breathe.
Misconception: Plants are not alive because they don't walk. Fact: Plants are very much alive; they breathe air, drink water, and make food.

visual_scenes.title: Living Puppy & Sprout (They Grow!)
visual_scenes.description: A happy puppy drinks water and wags its tail, while a small green plant sprout grows taller in the soil.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 1: Living things breathe, eat, drink water, and grow big!

visual_scenes.title: Non-Living Stone & Toy (They Don't Eat)
visual_scenes.description: A grey pebble and a toy wooden block rest quietly; they never eat or grow.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 2: Non-living things don't eat food or grow. They stay the same!

visual_scenes.title: Sorting Game: Living vs Non-Living
visual_scenes.description: A fun sorting basket where flowers and butterflies go to Living, and balls go to Non-Living.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 3: Great sorting! Nature is full of wonderful living friends!

sign_glossary.description: Both L-handshapes start at waist and move upward while changing into fists showing vitality.
Dominant hand emerges upward through non-dominant fist like a flower blooming.
Both Y-handshapes shake gently with playful twisting motion.

assessment_questions.question: Which of these is a LIVING thing that drinks water and grows?
assessment_questions.hint: It has green leaves and grows in soil.

assessment_questions.question: Does a teddy bear or toy car need to eat breakfast?
assessment_questions.expected_answer: No, it is a non-living thing
options: No, it is a non-living thing
Yes, it eats 5 bowls of cereal
Yes, it grows as tall as a tree
assessment_questions.hint: Toys do not eat real food.
